Colour and brightness record along a route on an image

Source: R/image.R
cd_image_profile.Rd

Samples an image along a route (a polyline of clicked points) at regular steps. At every step the pixels on a line perpendicular to the route (the swath) are averaged, which suppresses noise, cracks and small clasts. The distance along the route is converted to depth (or distance) with the scale of the image.

Usage

cd_image_profile(
  image,
  route,
  width = 15,
  step = 1,
  scale = NA,
  start = 0,
  direction = 1,
  stat = c("mean", "median")
)

Arguments

image

Path of a PNG, JPEG or TIFF image, or an array as returned by png::readPNG() (values 0-1).

route

The route: data frame or matrix with the x (column, from the left) and y (row, from the top) pixel coordinates of at least two points, in the order in which the record runs.

width

Width of the swath across the route in pixels (numeric, >= 1). Default=15.

step

Distance between samples along the route in pixels (numeric, > 0). Default=1.

scale

Pixels per unit of depth or distance (numeric, > 0), e.g. from a scale bar; NA gives the distance in pixels. Default=NA.

start

Depth or distance at the first point of the route (numeric). Default=0.

direction

1 when depth increases along the route, -1 when it decreases (e.g. a route clicked upwards on a core photograph with depth increasing downwards). Default=1.

stat

How the pixels of the swath are combined: "mean" or "median" (robust against cracks and specks). Default="mean".

Value

A data frame with one row per step: depth, distance_px, x, y (pixel position on the route), grey (luma, 0-255), L, a, b (CIE L*a*b*), R, G, B (0-255), hue (degrees), saturation and value (0-1). For a grey-scale image the colour columns repeat the grey value.

Examples

img <- array(0, dim = c(50, 200, 3))
for (j in 1:200) {
  img[, j, ] <- 0.5 + 0.4 * sin(2 * pi * j / 25)
}
prof <- cd_image_profile(img, data.frame(x = c(1, 200), y = c(25, 25)), width = 9, scale = 100)
plot(prof$depth, prof$grey, type = "l")
